reviewDepth.description: The deepest Annotation Layer a person has reviewed, every layer before it included: Segmentation (members, routes, No Target entries, coverage), Attestation, Reading, Knowledge. Leave it out for a Draft.

route.description: The target's Family and Kind in the record's language; its Attestation's Lemma has the same.

emojiDescription.description: One to four emoji: the Reading's identity, as Dumling normalizes it. A Foreign Reading has none.

paradigm.description: The forms, or the marker, this Reading licenses per Variation Dimension of its Lemma's Paradigm: plural (Pizzen, or NoPlural), preterite (stand auf), present1, present2, present3, pastParticiple, subjunctivePast.

coverage.description: Which Knowledge aspects and Variation Dimensions a person has covered: Authored when `knowledge` or `paradigm` holds one, ReviewedEmpty when it has none. Leave an unreviewed one out.

__schema593.description: Authored: the Knowledge holds this aspect. ReviewedEmpty: a person reviewed it and it has none.

__schema596.description: Which Variation Dimensions of the Lemma's Paradigm a person has covered: Authored when `paradigm` holds the dimension, ReviewedEmpty when this Reading takes none.
